items.issue: consolidate_findings.py silently drops reviewer finding lines that arrive bullet-prefixed (`- [BOB] ...`): _LINE_RE anchors on ^\[. Bob/codex emits exactly that shape, so in cycle 1 of 00320 all 13 of his findings were absent from the first consolidation, including the two sharpest correctness findings. Fix: tolerate an optional leading list marker in _LINE_RE, and add a fixture pinning the bullet-prefixed shape.
items.reason: found while consolidating 00320 cycle 1; worked around by stripping the prefix and re-consolidating. Needs its own PRD - it is a defect in the pack, not in 00320.
